records.title_en: Technical description: improvement of the Ancient Nemea junction–Dervenakia–Mycenae road, Argolis
records.locator: PDF pp. 32–35, printed pp. 32–35; Γέφυρα Γ3 description and typical bridge section, especially printed p. 35
family_names: Γέφυρα Γ3 – προεντεταμένη δοκός διπλού Τ
records.printed_dimensions: Bridge G3 proposal: 6 precast prestressed I/double-T girders per span, each 39.0 m long; beam depth 2.40 m, bottom flange width 0.90 m, top flange width 1.40 m, web thickness at mid-height 0.30 m; 2.40 m girder centre spacing. Each end has a 1.50–2.00 m long solid rectangular zone. Cast-in-place deck slab is 0.35 m thick.
records.missing_information: No fully dimensioned girder cross-section or fixed family code. Obtain design drawings for flange thicknesses, tapers, chamfers, end-block section and longitudinal transitions. This is a project design, not evidence of a standard Greek section or completed construction.
records.contact_route: Region of Peloponnese Directorate of Technical Works, identified on the PDF cover; staff contact is not printed in the inspected pages.

records.title_en: Investigation of the seismic response of a bridge with a pier founded on liquefiable soil
records.locator: Evgenia Eleftheriou (2020), PDF/printed pp. 15, 18–19; section 2.3 and Figures 8–9 (beam elevation/plan and cross-section)
family_names: Strymonas study bridge – ασύμμετρη δοκός διπλού Τ
records.printed_dimensions: Seven variable-section precast prestressed girders per 42 m span; beam length 40.5 m. Figure 9 midspan asymmetric I/double-T cross-section labels total depth 2.05 m, top flange width 1.25 m, bottom flange width 0.90 m and central web width 0.25 m; deck slab thickness 0.25 m. Figure 8 additionally shows a widened end/support zone and plan/elevation dimensions.
records.missing_information: Transcribe all Figure 8–9 contour dimensions and the variable section at support and along the 40.5 m girder before implementation. The thesis uses an assumed bridge/geotechnical model based on an existing Strymonas-area site; it does not establish that this precise girder was manufactured or is a national standard.
